name: Revit Checks (read-only eyes)
description: Read-only measuring tools for a live Revit session: wall joins, solid intersections, warnings baseline and delta, wall orientation, openings, roofs, family probe, MEP system report, naming and parameter checks, levels and grids, and a one-call phase review. Each runs a vetted embedded script, never opens a transaction, and returns a short summary, FAIL lines, and a detail file for long lists.
author: AEC Model Bridge

ids.description: Revit ElementIds (integers) to check. Takes precedence over tag and categories.

tag.description: Prefix of the Comments parameter that marks the elements of one build phase (for example AMB_V2:p3_walls). Elements whose Comments start with it are checked.

categories.description: Category names to scan, for example ["Walls","Floors"] (OST_ names also work). Used together with tag, or alone to scan one category.

max_elements.description: Safety cap on the number of elements selected; the tool refuses larger selections instead of running long.

allow_free_ids.description: Wall ids whose free ends are intended (for example a freestanding or gable end); they are reported as INFO instead of FAIL.

limit.description: Maximum rows, FAIL lines and INFO lines returned per list (default 50, maximum 500). The full lists go to detail_file when anything is cut.

offset.description: Skip this many rows and lines first, to read the next page of a truncated list.

count_only.description: Return only the summary and the counts (no fails, info or rows). Use for a cheap yes/no after a phase.

fields.description: Row fields to keep (for example ["wall_id","status"]); omit for all fields. Only affects rows.

set_a.description: Elements to test: an object with ids (list of integers), tag (Comments prefix) and/or categories (list of names). Required.

set_b.description: Optional second set (same shape as set_a). When given, only pairs with one element in set_a and one in set_b are tested; when omitted, set_a is tested against itself.

tolerance_m.description: Broad-phase bounding-box tolerance in metres (default 0). Positive widens the candidate test, negative demands penetration of at least that depth.

min_volume_m3.description: Smallest intersection volume in cubic metres that counts as a FAIL (default 0.0005).

mode.description: solid (default): measure the boolean intersection volume of the solids. bbox: bounding boxes only, like revit_check_clashes (false positives likely).

max_pairs.description: Stop after this many bounding-box candidate pairs and report a partial result (default 20000).

time_budget_s.description: Stop after this many seconds (default 20, maximum 25) and report a partial result; the bridge itself waits only 30 s.

skip_hosted.description: Ignore a hosted element (door, window) against its own host (default true).

commands.title: Audit Doors and Windows (host, cut, sill, swing)

ids.description: Revit ElementIds (integers) to check. Takes precedence over tag and categories.

data.description: Optional drawing data: {"openings": [{mark or id, wall, x_m, y_m, w_mm, h_mm, sill_mm, hinge: start|end, swing: exterior|interior, shape}]}. Adds host, position, size, sill and swing comparisons; without it the checks need no data.

pos_tol_m.description: Allowed distance between an opening and its data position in metres (default 0.08).

ray_test.description: Shoot a ray through each opening centre to prove it cuts the wall (needs a 3D view; default true). The wall volume drop is the fallback.

swing.description: Read the symbolic swing arc of each door in its floor plan and compare it with the hinge (default true).

max_fails_per_check.description: FAIL lines shown per check (default 10); all lines go to detail_file.
